title: Innate Immunity
description: The body's first answer, the same for every invader: cells that engulf what does not belong, and inflammation that walls it off. Unlocks Antibodies.

puzzle.goal: A phagocyte clears invaders at a rate proportional to how many are left: dN/dt = -cN. Write how many remain, M, after time t, from a start of N.
puzzle.name: First-order clearance
puzzle.ask: Find M for N = @{N}, c = @{c} and t = @{t}.
puzzle.method: Clearance proportional to the number left gives exponential decay, N.e^(-ct).
